title: Erdos Problem Solved
description:
A nearly century-old math problem has been cracked by an AI, leaving human mathematicians in awe
If this helped, subscribe for more stories with real sources. Comment your take below.
A nearly century-old math problem has been cracked by an AI, leaving human mathematicians in awe. The Erdős problem, proposed by Paul Erdős in 1939, is related to the concept of discrepancy in sequences and has far-reaching implications for number theory and algebra. The solution, achieved through machine learning, marks a significant milestone in the application of AI to complex mathematical problems.
